definitions.gloss: winning a bid; making the successful bid
definitions.explanation: Getting the item or contract by making the winning bid at an auction or a public tender. The thing won is the object: {絵|え}を{落札|らくさつ}する.

examples.english: I won the painting at auction.

examples.japanese: {落札|らくさつ}⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{百万円|ひゃくまんえん}だった。
examples.english: The winning bid was one million yen.

examples.japanese: ⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧オークション⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦カメラ→カメラ：04417_kamera⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{安|やす}く→安い：00464_yasui⟧{落札|らくさつ}⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I managed to win an old camera cheaply in an online auction.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{建設会社|けんせつがいしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{落札|らくさつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A local construction company won the tender for that work.

notes:
Used both for auctions (オークション, ⟦{競売|きょうばい}→競売：18523_kyoubai⟧) and for public works tenders (⟦{入札|にゅうさつ}→入札：20503_nyuusatsu⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {落札|らくさつ}⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧: winning bid price
- {落札者|らくさつしゃ}: winning bidder
- ⟦{高値|たかね}→高値：14703_takane⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{落札|らくさつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to win with a high bid
- {落札|らくさつ}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to be sold (to the highest bidder)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{入札|にゅうさつ}→入札：20503_nyuusatsu⟧: bidding, putting in a bid — the act of bidding, not winning
- {競|せ}り{落|お}とす: to outbid others and win (auctions only, more vivid)
